title: Concerning the Interpretation of the Five Words that are proclaimed in the Universe
teaching_text:
Once again the disciples [questioned the apostle. They say to] him: Recount to us, our master, of these five words that are procl[aim]ed in the sect of the Baptis[ts ... they] occur in other sects. [Also, thei]r name is proclaimed by they[w]ho are called 'Purified Ones', as they say this '[[First] Life' and the 'Second Life' ... ...] make a heart together with the mind [...] and the l[aw ...

[...] call it by this name is the Father, the l[ife ...] this unnameable, whom no one [...] his name.

⟨p.45⟩
The second [word is the Thir]d Ambassador [...] of life, whom they also call the father of [...] [...] the first Father.
gardner_synopsis: These five words appear to be the divine names used by other sects. Mani explains their significance by equating them with the appropriate Manichaean divinities. Mani was himself brought up in an Elchasaite community; and the Kephalaia makes a number of references to contemporary groups such as Baptists, Nazoreans, and Purified Ones (Catharioi). However, the exact identity of and relationship between these diverse Jewish-Christian sects remains unclear. The First and the Second Life are characteristic Mandaean terms.
